TOOLING BURST T4q — E0-p step 5: painted key states swapped into burst_v2 with correspondence + boil tests (Run C-5; architecture 03- § 2.2b step 5; charter § 6 burst template: "key states expanded + spent, painted over the tooling-transformed piece arrangement; correspondence (piece ↔ source within 1 px after transform) + boil (VO8 in band; shard count constant; contour thickening ≤ 1 px)"). task_id "T4q".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4a, T4d (VO namespace; VO8), T4e, T4h (all clauses) and the new row "T4q — key states" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/effect_kit.py, export/godot_import.py (piece_burst_v2), export/vfx_material.gdshader, oracle/peak_pieces.py (quantise/isolate), oracle/vfx_measure.py (VO8), the guides runs/C-5/artifacts/KS-guides/{guide_expanded_768.png, guide_spent_768.png, peak_768.png} (the runtime's own frames 15 and 36 at 1:1, and the peak on the same canvas), the paintings runs/C-5/artifacts/KS-fire-expanded-01/fire_expanded_01.png and runs/C-5/artifacts/KS-fire-spent-01/fire_spent_01.png (Astra EDITs over the guides; four-plane greyscale RGBA, 768² — inspect them: they may be 1254² or on green; isolate + quantise as T4e does), tests/test_effect_kit.py, tests/test_godot_import.py (extend only).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered = conductor's).

BUILD (minimal; legacy kits + v1 byte-identical): (1) `oracle/key_states.py`: register(painting, guide) → align the painting to its guide with ONE uniform scale + ONE translation (never per-piece warps), quantise to four bands, and report the CORRESPONDENCE test: for every T4e-r1 piece, the fraction of the guide piece's pixels covered by the painting's coverage (≥ 0.9) and the centroid offset of the painting's matching region vs the transformed piece (≤ 1 native px after the registration) — plus a whole-image boil report: VO8-style change rate between guide and painting (in band = the painting changes the drawing without changing the silhouette: silhouette IoU ≥ 0.9), shard count constant (connected components at α>0.5 within ±1 of the guide's), contour thickening ≤ 1 px (mean band-0 stroke width delta); write key_states.json + a side-by-side board (guide | painting | overlay); (2) `pieces` phase gains `key_states: [{state: "expanded", png, hold_frames, at_age}, {state: "spent", png, hold_frames, at_age}]` (default empty = today's v2 behaviour byte-for-byte): at `at_age` the runtime SWAPS the piece sprites for the single key-state sprite (on the T4a material, same palette, screen_px) for `hold_frames`, then swaps back to the pieces and continues — expanded at the end of expansion (age 15, hold 3–4 frames), spent at residue entry (age 36, hold 4–6 frames); erosion/dissolve uniforms continue on the key-state sprite so the schedule is unbroken; (3) CONDUCTOR PRE-READ of the paintings (raw, unregistered): the SPENT painting sits close to its guide (silhouette IoU 0.53 raw); the EXPANDED painting is a coherent flame but RE-COMPOSED — longer tongues, shifted roots (IoU 0.27 raw) — the model repainted the arrangement rather than in place. Therefore implement TWO bindings and report both: (a) RAW — the registered painting as is; (b) CLIPPED — the registered painting intersected with the guide silhouette dilated by 2 px (the guide alpha is the shape contract; the painting supplies the interior planes and the healed seams inside it), with any guide pixels the painting leaves uncovered filled from the guide itself. Run correspondence + boil on both. Bind to fire_burst_e0p_v2 the CLIPPED form of each state whose clipped report passes; bind nothing that fails; report which test failed and by how much (report-not-stop).
Tests (unittest, stdlib): registration recovers a known scale+translation on a synthetic pair; correspondence/boil metrics on a synthetic guide and a perturbed copy (pass) and on a mismatched pair (fail); the swap emission (headless clock trace shows the swap at age 15/36 and the return); legacy hash table unchanged; headless import exit 0.
ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/T4q/acceptance.json): the two reports with every number; pass/fail per state; in-sandbox suite reds named.

DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, export/replay.py, oracle/peak_pieces.py, oracle/vfx_measure.py (read only), any test file except the two named (extend only), anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/T4q/, runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_burst_e0p_v2/ (kit.json + the two key-state PNGs you place there). Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under runs/C-5/t3/T4q/. Write out/files.json listing every file you changed with sha256.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T4q"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
